name: lineup
description: Companion to spitball. Manages a rolling 3-slot view (At Bat / On Deck / In the Hole) of work toward a spitball's destination. Three skills: lineup (reviewer) sharpens the next at-bat and verifies a just-completed at-bat's Definition of done; at-bat (implementer) does the work with red/green testing - including an early testability gate that stops before code is written if verification needs human eyes - and hands off to lineup; postmortem reflects on at-bat history once a spitball is delivered (or when something broke).
